user.title: Connect your TextNow account
user.description:
Home Assistant needs the cookies from a browser that is signed in to TextNow. The quickest way, with no header hunting:

1. Sign in to [textnow.com](https://www.textnow.com) in a desktop browser (Chrome, Edge or Firefox).
2. Press **F12** to open developer tools and pick the **Network** tab.
3. Reload the page, then type `messages` in the filter box.
4. Right-click the first row and choose **Copy → Copy as cURL**.
5. Paste it in the **Cookies** box below and leave **Username** empty — both are read from the paste.

A plain cookie line works too: in the same row, look under *Request headers* for **cookie** and copy the whole line. In that case fill in the username from **Settings → Account** on textnow.com.

[Instructions with screenshots]({help_url})

data_description.username: Leave empty to read it from the paste. Otherwise use the username from Settings → Account on textnow.com, without the @.
data_description.cookie_string: Paste a *Copy as cURL* command or the whole cookie line. Everything in the paste is kept, including the bot-protection cookies that make Home Assistant look like your browser.

reauth_confirm.description:

error.username_required: Enter the TextNow username from Settings → Account, or paste a *Copy as cURL* command so it can be read from the request.
error.no_cookies: No cookies were found in that text. Paste the whole cookie line from your browser.
error.connect_sid_missing: The paste has no connect.sid cookie, which is the one that carries the sign-in session. Copy the cookie line again while signed in to TextNow.
error.csrf_missing: The paste has neither the _csrf nor the XSRF-TOKEN cookie. Copy the whole cookie line, not just part of it.
error.invalid_auth: TextNow rejected these credentials. The cookies may already have expired, or the username may not match the account they belong to.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach www.textnow.com. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.unexpected_response: TextNow replied with something unexpected. See the Home Assistant log for the details.
error.invalid_phone: Phone number must be exactly 10 digits
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for the details.

expired_session.title: TextNow needs new cookies
expired_session.description:
TextNow no longer accepts the saved browser session for {account}, so messages can neither be sent nor received. Polling has been paused so Home Assistant stops hammering TextNow with a session it has rejected.

Open **Settings → Devices & services → TextNow** and follow the re-authentication prompt to paste a fresh cookie line. Your contacts and automations are kept.

bot_blocked.title: TextNow blocked Home Assistant
bot_blocked.description:
TextNow's bot protection rejected the requests for {account} (HTTP 403). Polling has been paused.

Sign in to TextNow in a normal browser, solve any challenge it shows, then copy a fresh cookie line and paste it into the re-authentication prompt under **Settings → Devices & services → TextNow**. Copy the *whole* cookie line: the bot-protection cookies are part of what makes the requests acceptable. Increasing the polling interval in the integration options also reduces how often this happens.
